description: Source code for team management API endpoints in Mattermost, including team creation, deletion, invitation, and related operations.

methods.name: localDeleteTeam
methods.description: Handles deletion (soft or permanent) of a team based on request parameters.

methods.name: localInviteUsersToTeam
methods.description: Handles inviting users to a team via email, with support for graceful error handling and email validation.

methods.name: isEmailAddressAllowed
methods.description: Checks if an email address matches allowed domain restrictions.

methods.name: normalizeDomains
methods.description: Normalizes domain restriction strings into a list of domain names.

methods.name: localCreateTeam
methods.description: Creates a new team from JSON request body, with audit logging.
